title: Security Audit
scope: Full platform security review covering XSS, SQL injection, file upload, and API authentication

findings.details: React automatically escapes JSX expressions, preventing most XSS attacks. All dashboard pages use React's built-in escaping.
findings.recommendation: Continue using React JSX for all rendered content. Never use dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

findings.details: Backend API returns JSON responses only — no HTML rendering on server side. Fastify serializes all responses as JSON.
findings.recommendation: Maintain JSON-only API responses. Add Content-Type: application/json header enforcement.

mitigations: React's built-in XSS protection via JSX escaping

findings.details: All database queries use Prisma ORM which parameterizes all queries automatically. No raw SQL queries found in the codebase.
findings.recommendation: Continue using Prisma's query builder exclusively. Never use prisma.$queryRaw or prisma.$executeRaw with user input.

mitigations: TypeScript type safety prevents string concatenation in queries

findings.details: File upload endpoints exist for evidence processing. Current implementation needs hardening.
missingControls: File type whitelist enforcement (allow only PDF, DOCX, MP4, WAV, JPG, PNG)
Maximum file size enforcement at server level
Malicious file content scanning (e.g., ClamAV integration)
File name sanitization (prevent path traversal via ../)
Storage isolation (uploaded files should not be web-accessible)
findings.recommendation: Implement @fastify/multipart with strict file type validation, size limits, and content scanning before production deployment

findings.details: Document download worker (documentValidationService.ts) includes validation checks for downloaded policy documents.

mitigations: Worker-based processing isolates file handling from API layer
requiredActions: Add virus/malware scanning for uploaded files
Sanitize all file names to prevent path traversal

findings.details: All 87 API endpoints are currently accessible without authentication. The frontend uses ProtectedRoute component for page-level access control, but backend API routes have no auth middleware.
findings.recommendation: CRITICAL — Add JWT or session-based authentication middleware to all API routes before production deployment

findings.details: Frontend implements role-based access control via ProtectedRoute component with requiredPermission checks (canViewAdmin, etc.).

requiredActions: Implement Fastify auth plugin (fastify-jwt or fastify-auth)
Add authentication middleware to all /api/* routes
Implement role-based API access control (staff, attorney, admin)
Add API key support for service-to-service communication
Implement session management with secure cookie settings

findings.details: backend/.env file exists and should never be committed to version control.
findings.recommendation: Ensure .env is in .gitignore. Use environment-specific secrets management in production.

findings.details: API error responses use generic 500 error messages. Stack traces are not exposed to clients.
findings.recommendation: Verify Fastify error handler does not leak stack traces in production mode

findings.details: Safety guardrail system (Phase 150) ensures all compliance findings use neutral language. No accusatory statements in API responses.

csrfProtection.recommendation: Add CSRF token validation for all state-changing API requests (POST, PUT, DELETE). Consider @fastify/csrf-protection plugin.

headerSecurity.recommendation: Add security headers via @fastify/helmet: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy

criticalIssues: No API authentication middleware — all 87 endpoints are open
highRiskIssues: API authentication gaps must be resolved before production
lowRiskIssues: XSS risk mitigated by React and JSON-only API
SQL injection risk mitigated by Prisma ORM
requiredBeforeGoLive: Add JWT authentication middleware to all API routes
Implement file upload validation and scanning
Implement API key management for service accounts
Set up HTTPS/TLS termination at load balancer
